verdict.rationale: skills.sh's CLI explicitly supports project-level installs that are 'committed with your project, shared with team' [skills-cli-gh-24][skills-cli-gh-40], installing from GitHub/GitLab/Azure repos including private ones with existing auth [skills-cli-gh-9][skills-cli-gh-44][skills-cli-gh-46], non-interactive CI/CD installs [skills-cli-gh-8][skills-cli-gh-31], symlinked canonical copies for single-source updates [skills-cli-gh-16][skills-cli-gh-38], lockfile-based restore [skills-cli-docs-2][skills-cli-docs-5], and a public skills.sh leaderboard/marketplace for discovery [skills-cli-docs-6]. missing for 10: independent case study of a team actually standardizing skills this way, and a documented API/programmatic distribution path (a commenter explicitly requested a REST API) [skills-cli-comm-6]; community also flagged the marketplace ranking as opaque/self-serving [skills-cli-comm-1][skills-cli-comm-3], which tempers trust in the marketplace channel specifically without contradicting the repo/file distribution paths.
